digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC integration tests / provenance oracle
propositions: the provenance test asserts remote_key (e.g. 'RBJNAZV-1') via case-sensitive substring scan of json.dumps(ticket), but ticket id is lowercased ('jira-rbjnazv-1'), making the match impossible
the inbound create path writes ticket payload without the raw Jira key; the DC↔local correspondence is stored only in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return
the test cannot distinguish between 'ticket was created correctly' and 'ticket was not created' because its assertion targets an assumed output shape rather than what the code actually emits
the fix must match ticket id exactly against _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally assert the binding store maps that local id to remote_key
